$comment: Every src file that acquires a webview client API (acquireVsCodeApi(...)) ships a browser-side script that runs in the webview renderer — invisible to the extension-host, e2e, and output-channel lanes, so a thrown error there only surfaces when a human opens the panel. check:webview-coverage requires each such file to be EITHER covered by a jsdom client-script test under test/unit/webview/ (status 'tested' — the file's basename must appear in a webview test) OR classified 'backlog' (e2e-able via the webview harness, not yet — printed every run as visible debt). Fails on a new unclassified client-script file and on stale entries, so webview coverage can't silently regress.
